title: Lucid moment followed by an "angry mob"

classification.question_topic: Lucid moment followed by appearance of hostile/angry dream people who seemed to object to lucidity; asking what it was.

meta.author_theory: Speculates whether the reaction was subconscious defensiveness, intruding on someone else's dreamscape, or encountering parasitic entities.

interactions.description: Sustained lucidity longer than usual; kept focus long enough to float forward faster in the dream scene for a longer time.

A bunch of random dream people popped up out of nowhere, suddenly eyeing the dreamer and tried to 'straight up moshpit' them out of the dream; gave looks like 'you're not supposed to be here' / 'hey you can't do that here.'

entities_involved.description: Random dream people appearing suddenly; 'angry mob' / moshpit behavior; eyeing the dreamer with disapproving/territorial looks.

interactions.description: Retained lucidity briefly but had no control over the dream location; the scene became much more chaotic.

extraction.extraction_notes: No concrete place descriptions (e.g., mall/school/hotel) were provided; interactions are anchored to an unspecified 'dream scene.' A placeholder location_id (loc_1) is used to attach events.
